OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 and 'Intelligent UI'

This shift moves ChatGPT from a text-based chatbot toward an interactive application platform. However, OpenAI's own system card notes minor safety benchmark regressions compared to the previous version, suggesting that as the interface gets more capable, the underlying safety filters are still being tuned.
